249 | export function printHelp(extensionFlags?: ExtensionFlag[]): void {
250 | 	const extensionFlagsText =
251 | 		extensionFlags && extensionFlags.length > 0
252 | 			? `\n${chalk.bold("Extension CLI Flags:")}\n${extensionFlags
253 | 					.map((flag) => {
254 | 						const value = flag.type === "string" ? " <value>" : "";
255 | 						const description = flag.description ?? `Registered by ${flag.extensionPath}`;
256 | 						return `  --${flag.name}${value}`.padEnd(30) + description;
257 | 					})
258 | 					.join("\n")}\n`
259 | 			: "";
260 | 	console.log(`${chalk.bold(APP_NAME)} - AI coding assistant with read, bash, edit, write tools
261 | 
262 | ${chalk.bold("Usage:")}
263 |   ${APP_NAME} [options] [@files...] [messages...]
264 | 
265 | ${chalk.bold("Commands:")}
266 |   ${APP_NAME} install <source> [-l]     Install extension source and add to settings
267 |   ${APP_NAME} remove <source> [-l]      Remove extension source from settings
268 |   ${APP_NAME} uninstall <source> [-l]   Alias for remove
269 |   ${APP_NAME} update [source|self|ice]   Update ice, extensions, or model catalogs
270 |   ${APP_NAME} list                      List installed extensions from settings
271 |   ${APP_NAME} config [-l]               Open TUI to enable/disable package resources (Tab switches scope)
272 |   ${APP_NAME} auth <command>            Print credentials for external clients
273 |   ${APP_NAME} <command> --help          Show help for install/remove/uninstall/update/list/config/auth
274 | 
275 | ${chalk.bold("Options:")}
276 |   --provider <name>              Provider name (default: google)
277 |   --model <pattern>              Model pattern or ID (supports "provider/id" and optional ":<thinking>")
278 |   --api-key <key>                API key (defaults to env vars)
279 |   --system-prompt <text>         System prompt (default: coding assistant prompt)
280 |   --append-system-prompt <text>  Append text or file contents to the system prompt (can be used multiple times)
281 |   --mode <mode>                  Output mode: text (default), json, or rpc
282 |   --observe[=port]               Serve a live observability dashboard on 127.0.0.1 (default port 4649)
283 |   --print, -p                    Non-interactive mode: process prompt and exit
284 |   --continue, -c                 Continue previous session
285 |   --resume, -r                   Select a session to resume
286 |   --session <path|id>            Use specific session file or partial UUID
287 |   --session-id <id>              Use exact project session ID, creating it if missing
288 |   --fork <path|id>               Fork specific session file or partial UUID into a new session
289 |   --session-dir <dir>            Directory for session storage and lookup
290 |   --no-session                   Don't save session (ephemeral)
291 |   --name, -n <name>              Set session display name
292 |   --models <patterns>            Comma-separated model patterns for Ctrl+P cycling
293 |                                  Supports globs (anthropic/*, *sonnet*) and fuzzy matching
294 |   --no-tools, -nt                Disable all tools by default (built-in and extension)
295 |   --no-builtin-tools, -nbt       Disable built-in tools by default but keep extension/custom tools enabled
